object.attr: as implemented: PNG files and draw.io's compressed .drawio files are refused when attaching (MELLON-EDIT-SRS). The namespace is SVG's own (review Q26). A figure that isn't well-formed SVG is a validation error in MELLON-CHECK-SRS (D-C7).
object.description: A figure file shall be an SVG file whose root element is svg in the namespace http://www.w3.org/2000/svg.
